entries.text: Flight log: the mk 12 held together like a dream through the canyon pass. those welds i did on the stabilizer were worth every spark. she handled the descent into hangar bay 3 perfectly, not even a wobbly bolt to report.
took the Little Dart Mk 12 up for a test flight: smooth
